run_model_free_ptq_nvfp4a16: run model_free_ptq to apply NVFP4A16 quantization to a reindexed Kimi-K2-Thinking model
reindex_fused_weights_cli: run llmcompressor.reindex_fused_weights CLI to merge fused module weights into single safetensors files
run_model_free_ptq_mxfp4a16: run model_free_ptq with MXFP4A16 scheme to quantize a reindexed safetensors model directory
run_model_free_ptq_ignore_patterns: run model_free_ptq with ignore patterns to skip gate, lm_head, and embedding layers during quantization
run_model_free_ptq_cuda_device: run model_free_ptq on cuda:0 device with max_workers=15 for parallel quantization of large model
